> **Don't disclose details publicly.** If the issue is sensitive, email `souravmondal033@gmail.com` instead of opening a public issue.

See [docs/SECURITY.md](../../docs/SECURITY.md) for the threat model and reporting flow.

## Summary

One sentence describing the issue.

## Severity (your read)

- [ ] Critical — data exposure, account takeover, or worse
- [ ] High — moderate data exposure or privilege escalation
- [ ] Medium — limited impact, requires specific conditions
- [ ] Low — informational / hardening suggestion

## Affected area

Which collection / endpoint / file does this involve?

## Reproduction

Step-by-step. If you have a PoC, include it. Don't include real user data — anonymise where possible.

## Suggested fix

If you have an idea, share it. Otherwise leave blank.
